fahrzeug.title: EV Assistant - Vehicle
fahrzeug.description: Step 1/7: Vehicle details. Usable battery capacity: the value actually available for driving/charging — NOT the larger gross/factory spec (e.g. 58 kWh gross, but only 52 kWh usable). This value directly determines how many kWh one SoC percentage point equals — if entered incorrectly, all energy estimates will be wrong.

evcc.title: EV Assistant - evcc & Wallbox
evcc.description: Step 2/7: Wallbox and site entities (charge power, PV, grid, tariffs, statistics) are automatically imported from the evcc integration. Only needed here: the vehicle name in evcc (filters home-charging history) and the power entity of your wallbox. The wallbox power entity is used for yes/no detection of 'currently charging at home' — without it, every SoC increase will be incorrectly classified as external charging.

ladeleistung.title: EV Assistant - Charge Power
ladeleistung.description: Step 3/7: optional vehicle charge power and wallbox energy measurement. The vehicle charge power improves energy estimates for external charging sessions. The wallbox energy meter is a cumulative kWh counter — it enables charging efficiency calibration and home-charging cost tracking in step 7.

data.power_is_ac: Charge power is AC-side (charge point) not DC-side (battery)

ausgabe.title: EV Assistant - Notifications
ausgabe.description: Step 4/7: how you get notified about a detected external charging session. A notification in the HA 'Notifications' area appears AUTOMATICALLY — a notify service additionally sends a push message (e.g. to your phone).

erkennung.title: EV Assistant - Detection
erkennung.description: Step 5/7: fine-tuning of external charging detection. Default values work for most cases. Flow: charging starts when SoC rises by the start threshold; ends on SoC drop below the peak or after timeout. SoC noise must ALWAYS be smaller than the start threshold.

data.start_delta: Start threshold (%, minimum SoC rise to count as charging)
data.noise: SoC noise (%, tolerance — must be smaller than the start threshold!)

fahrtenbuch.title: EV Assistant - Trip Log
fahrtenbuch.description: Step 6/7: fine-tuning of automatic trip detection, which uses the same odometer sensor from step 1. Default values work for most cases.

vergleich.title: EV Assistant - Cost Comparison
vergleich.description: Step 7/7: Optional cost comparison against a combustion vehicle. All fields optional. Home-charging costs require a wallbox energy meter from step 3. Fixed value OR entity — the entity takes precedence.

data.home_price_entity: Home electricity price entity (overrides fixed price)
